Dropshipping niches That actually work in South Africa!🇿🇦  When someone asks me, “What should I sell? How do I start?” — one of the first things I look at is how sustainable the niche is. Ask yourself: 👉 How long has this niche been around? 👉 Do people consistently buy these products? 👉 Is there already demand on social media? 👉 Do you actually understand the customer and the products? 👉 Can the niche survive beyond one viral trend? Think about categories like wigs & hair, sneakers, jewellery, beauty and wellness products. These are categories people have been buying for years — not just because one product went viral for a few weeks. The goal isn’t always to chase the next winning product. Sometimes, the smarter move is building around a niche with proven, ongoing demand and then finding products, offers and content that give customers a reason to buy from your brand. 🔥 Trends can come and go. 🔥 Customer demand is what you want to build around. Build for longevity, not just virality.
